headline: Postponed approval of August 11th minutes to allow for corrections; no other business was decided.
summary: Technical issues prevented a confidential session, and the meeting was adjourned early. Approval of the August 11th minutes was postponed to the next meeting so corrections could be made. No public comment, correspondence, or old or new business was discussed.
decisions: Postponed approval of the August 11th minutes to the next meeting so specific corrections can be made.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of the August 11th minutes was postponed to the next meeting to allow for specific corrections.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Board of Ethics Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, September 8, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Commissioner Philip Kent called the meeting to order at 7:23 PM because of technical 
issues.  
2. ATTENDANCE   
  B&C clerk Porsche Edmondson took attendance. Present: Philip Kent, Chair, Ann Pari, 
Deirdre Moody, Ellen Rosenthal, Attorney Sue Gruen, Edward Simon, and Lynda 
Rosenfeld.  
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 Approval of the August 11th minutes was postponed to the next meeting to allow for 
specific corrections.  
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No one from the public was present. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No correspondence to mention at this time. 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 Attorney Sue Gruen stated that there was no need to go into an executive session at this 
time. Commissioner Philip Kent proposed that they go into a confidential session.  All were 
in favor. 
7. REPORTS   
 There were no new reports to speak of. 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 No old business to speak of. 
9. NEW BUSINESS
No new business to speak of at this time. Due to technical issues, they were unable to hold 
a sufficient confidential session.  
  
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 The meeting was officially adjourned at 7:47 PM due to the inability to secure a private 
breakout room. 
Philip Kent moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:47 PM, and it was seconded by Ellen 
Rosenthal.  
Minutes for this meeting were taken by the B & C clerk, Porsche Edmondson.
